title: OptionOpenItem
description: plan.option_open_item r1: one planned contract of the option open pull, written by the plan job before the pull.

session_day.description: Market-zone session date the plan is for.

slot.description: Slot of the pull as four digits, for example 0945.

plan_id.description: Identifier of the plan run. The pull reads the latest plan of the session day and slot, the one with the greatest planned_at.

planned_at.description: Instant the plan was made, UTC.

class.description: Class of the contract, in the order of the ceilings.

deferred.description: True when the contract is over a ceiling; it keeps its class and is not asked.

rank.description: Position of the contract in the order of the pull.

planned_spot.description: Spot of the underlying the plan used.

sigma.description: Implied volatility as a decimal that sized the strike band.
